hooks.command: i=$(cat); case $i in *mod-cache*) h="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/vendor/grado-factorio-tools/scripts/refuse-cd-into-mod-cache.ps1"; if [ -f "$h" ]; then printf '%s' "$i" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$h" -Root "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" -CacheName .mod-cache; else echo "refuse-cd-into-mod-cache: $h not found, so the command was NOT checked. Run: git submodule update --init" >&2; exit 1; fi;; esac

i=$(cat); case $i in *npm*|*npx*|*pip*|*gem*|*cargo*|*winget*|*choco*|*scoop*|*release*download*|*.exe*|*.msi*|*.zip*|*.tar.gz*|*.tgz*) printf '%s' "$i" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/ask-before-download.ps1";; esac
